description: AbstractPartitionBasedService is an abstract Java class that manages partitioned entities and their fetch tasks, handles partition change events, and coordinates partition management logic within the Thingsboard server.

classes.name: AbstractPartitionBasedService
classes.description: An abstract class for managing partitioned entities and handling partition change events in a distributed system.

methods.name: getPartitionedEntities
methods.description: Returns the set of entities associated with a specific partition.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the scheduled executor for partition management tasks.

methods.name: getServiceType
methods.description: Returns the service type, defaulting to ServiceType.TB_CORE.

methods.name: onTbApplicationEvent
methods.description: Handles partition change events, adding new partitions to the queue and scheduling database polling.

methods.name: filterTbApplicationEvent
methods.description: Filters events based on service type.

methods.name: pollInitStateFromDB
methods.description: Triggers fetching the latest partition state from the database.

methods.name: initStateFromDB
methods.description: Initializes or updates the internal state based on current partitions, handling additions and removals.

methods.name: logFailure
methods.description: Logs errors during partition fetch tasks, ignoring cancellations.

methods.name: logPartitions
methods.description: Logs current managed partitions and entity counts.

methods.name: onRepartitionEvent
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to handle repartition events.

methods.name: getLatestPartitions
methods.description: Retrieves the latest set of partitions from the queue.
